reviews.title: Great Laptop in the Rampocalypse Era
reviews.body: Long time Lenovo user and thought I should give HP a try for this CPU generation. Very happy with this laptop overall. It has a premium feel and look, and it handles both my work and a heavy gaming load without breaking a sweat. I genuinely couldn’t be happier with the performance and build quality

reviews.title: Nice Laptop, but with minor issues
reviews.body:
I bought this HP because of the small design, Intel Series 3 CPU/IGPU combo which I thought would give me excellent battery life and gaming performance.
It does, to a point, but not nearly as good as what I had hoped.
The Laptop's gaming performance is not nearly as good with the B390 as the 140V on
reviews.excerpt: For what you pay for and get, you might as well get a Gaming Laptop or get an ASUS that will allow you to play older games.
